decisions.rationale: Strong vanishing lines would make the architecture too assertive for the restrained portrait.
Photorealism is already literal in the frozen core and needs no candidate transformation.
A partial crop could hide the formal floor-length silhouette or folded wings.
Full-body framing is already part of the frozen baseline rather than an added candidate idea.
A turned body would reduce the clarity of the two-handed tea-pouring action.
The final off-center balance was independently authored around the window and tea service, without adopting this candidate.

negative_en: plastic-looking skin, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, over-processed retouching, low resolution, body distortion, excessive HDR, illustration look, 3D render look
prompt_en: A photorealistic Gothic fashion portrait of an unmistakably adult woman, with the attached portrait as the sole facial and hair reference, appearing as a solemn fallen-angel maid. She stands in a candlelit manor library and carefully pours tea from a tarnished silver pot into a black porcelain cup. Her formal floor-length black satin maid dress has a high lace collar, fitted long sleeves, a structured waist, ivory cuffs, a layered ankle-length skirt, and a crisp lace headpiece, creating dignified Gothic fashion. Broad charcoal wings fold behind her, a fractured dark halo floats above, and loose feathers rest across the polished floor. Preserve her warm brown almond-shaped eyes, soft oval face, adult facial proportions, natural skin texture, and long glossy wavy black hair. Her expression is calm and self-possessed. Frame her full figure slightly off center so the arched window outlines one folded wing and the tea service balances the opposite side. A narrow silver moonlight rim meets amber candlelight across feathers and satin. Full-body vertical composition, 50mm lens, realistic textures, restrained color, shallow depth of field. Avoid: plastic-looking skin, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, over-processed retouching, low resolution, body distortion, excessive HDR, illustration look, 3D render look
